title: I spent two months using the Eureka Ergonomic Wonder Glowing Glass Desk, and it's beautiful — but there's one small problem
summary: When it comes to the best gaming desks or best standing desks , the Eureka Ergonomic Wonder Glowing Glass Desk is suitable for both categories. I'm 5ft 4in, and I think anyone under that would struggle with this desk.
